report.headline: 73 nodes and 183 edges across 1 component
observations: NetworkX identified 6 communities and retained 111 key edges for simplified investigation views.

3 strong behavioural links derived from the weighted correlation engine.
All entities and evidence form a single connected component - consistent with one coordinated activity.
